newsitem.title: USA: US Senate panel to vote on Barshefsky Thursday.
newsitem.headline: US Senate panel to vote on Barshefsky Thursday.

text.p: The Senate Finance Committee will consider the nomination of Charlene Barshefsky for U.S. Trade Representative Thursday.
If the panel approves her nomination it would then go before the full Senate for a vote.
The committee, which held a hearing on the nomination Wednesday, will also consider a waiver related to the nomination Thursday, a committee spokeswoman said.

Barshefsky's nomination to the post has been complicated by a law barring anyone from the post if they have represented a foreign government on trade matters. She represented Canadian lumber interests while she was a Washington lawyer.
The waiver must be approved by both the Senate and the House.
Committee Chairman William Roth, a Republican from Delaware, said at the end of the hearing that it appeared Barshefsky had strong bipartisan support on the panel.
